verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own RTX 5080 page documents a hardware media engine, the ninth-gen NVENC for fast video exports, and claims general acceleration for video editing, 3D rendering and graphic design. It does not name the AV1 or HEVC codecs, and nothing in the pack mentions Studio drivers or ISV certification. missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encode/decode documentation, NVDEC or encoder-count details, Studio/ISV-certified driver claims, named creator-app integrations, independent hands-on corroboration of encoder performance.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it

citations.quote: Harness the power of the ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder (NVENC) for blazing-fast video exports
GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs unlock transformative performance in video editing, 3D rendering, and graphic design.
